Hello Vasiliy,

Noted on both points, and both are easy ones.

On the firmware: Harlo OS is optional, never required, and we do not reflash units as part of fulfilment. Your 30T is intended to arrive with the factory firmware it was built with, so there is nothing you need to undo on first boot. If you ever change your mind later, Harlo OS is a download you run yourself from harlolabs.com, and staying on the stock firmware does not affect your warranty or your ability to point the miner at any pool you like.

On checking the unit before it goes out: I have put your request on order ····-A and a colleague is picking it up today, so you get a confirmation from them directly in this thread rather than from me, since I do not have the warehouse side in front of me.

If anything looks off when you first power it up, write back here with the model, the firmware version shown in the web interface and a photo of the screen, and I will take it from there.

Best regards,
Hal, HeliumDeploy Technical Support
